_readme: Every spoken line in the game. Edit text here, then run tools/generate_voices.py to record the new lines. To use real recordings, drop a WAV or OGG named <id>.wav / <id>.ogg into audio/voice/. 'next' chains another line after this one.

ch1_intro.speaker: leo
ch1_intro.text: Halloween night. My costume's half off and my pillowcase is SO heavy.

ch1_mom_bedtime.speaker: mom
ch1_mom_bedtime.text: Leo! Ten more minutes, then it's bed. I mean it this time.

tv_first.speaker: leo
tv_first.text: The Halloween special again. I've seen it twice this week. Watching it anyway.

tv_repeat.speaker: leo
tv_repeat.text: Commercials. That's the robot car I circled in the catalog. Twice.

tv_show_announcer.speaker: tv
tv_show_announcer.text: Stay tuned for more Spooky Hollow, right after these messages!

tv_ad_announcer.speaker: tv
tv_ad_announcer.text: Mega Robo Racer! It climbs walls! Batteries not included.

tv_signoff.speaker: tv
tv_signoff.text: This concludes our broadcast day. Goodnight.

candy_first.speaker: leo
candy_first.text: Trade pile. Keep pile. The full-size bar from the fog machine house goes straight in keep.

mask_first.speaker: leo
mask_first.text: The elastic left a red line on my cheek. It still smells like plastic and the costume aisle.

window_first.speaker: leo
window_first.text: Porch lights all the way down the street. Some big kids are still out. No costumes, just pillowcases.

window_repeat.speaker: leo
window_repeat.text: My breath fogs up the glass. I draw a smiley face before anybody sees.

sib_first_b.speaker: leo
sib_first_b.text: Fine. They just turned the guitar music up.

sib_repeat.speaker: leo
sib_repeat.text: I'll just sit here for a while. They're laughing at something on the computer.

front_door_ch1.speaker: leo
front_door_ch1.text: Mom said no more going out tonight.

switch_ch1.speaker: leo
switch_ch1.text: Mom says the porch light stays on till the last trick-or-treaters go home.

dog_pet_1.speaker: leo
dog_pet_1.text: Good boy, Biscuit. Who's a good boy?

dog_pet_2.speaker: leo
dog_pet_2.text: He smells like leaves and outside.

dog_pet_3.speaker: leo
dog_pet_3.text: No, Biscuit. The candy's mine. Chocolate is bad for dogs.

dog_pet_4.speaker: leo
dog_pet_4.text: His tail's going so fast his whole butt wiggles.

couch.speaker: leo
couch.text: Just for a minute. The TV's getting quieter and quieter.

dream_enter.speaker: leo
dream_enter.text: The hallway's longer than it should be.

dream_door.speaker: leo
dream_door.text: It's warm on the other side. It smells like Grandma's kitchen.

wake.speaker: leo
wake.text: Somebody turned off the porch light. I don't remember getting a blanket.

ch2_dog_door.speaker: leo
ch2_dog_door.text: Biscuit? What's wrong, buddy? You gotta go out?

front_door_dark.speaker: leo
front_door_dark.text: It's way too dark out there. I need the porch light.

front_door_open.speaker: leo
front_door_open.text: Okay, okay. Go on, but stay on the porch.

porch_steps_block.speaker: leo
porch_steps_block.text: I'm not allowed off the porch at night.

pumpkin.speaker: leo
pumpkin.text: Our jack-o'-lantern. Dad carved the teeth way too big.

candy_bowl.speaker: leo
candy_bowl.text: The candy bowl's empty. Somebody took the whole thing. Probably the big kids.

porch_quiet.speaker: leo
porch_quiet.text: It's so quiet. Where'd all the crickets go?

lights_out.speaker: leo
lights_out.text: They're going out. One at a time.

last_light.speaker: leo
last_light.text: Except that one. At the very end. It's the same orange as Grandma's porch.

dad_1.speaker: dad
dad_1.text: Leo? Buddy, what are you doing out here? It's two in the morning.

dad_2.speaker: dad
dad_2.text: Come on. Inside. Biscuit, you too.

leo_final.speaker: leo
leo_final.text: Dad? Did you see the light at the end of the street?

ch3_intro.speaker: leo
ch3_intro.text: I can't sleep. Dad went back to bed, but I keep thinking about that light.

ch3_window.speaker: leo
ch3_window.text: It's still on. All the way at the end of the street. Everything else is dark.

ch3_window_repeat.speaker: leo
ch3_window_repeat.text: It's not blinking or anything. It's just waiting.

ch3_dog_tags.speaker: leo
ch3_dog_tags.text: Biscuit's at the door again. He wants to go too.

ch3_flashlight.speaker: leo
ch3_flashlight.text: Dad's flashlight. The one for when the power goes out.

ch3_door_not_ready.speaker: leo
ch3_door_not_ready.text: Not in my socks. And it's way too dark without a flashlight.

ch3_door_open.speaker: leo
ch3_door_open.text: Shh, Biscuit. If Dad wakes up I'm grounded till Christmas.

ch3_couch.speaker: leo
ch3_couch.text: I already tried. My eyes won't stay shut.

ch3_tv.speaker: leo
ch3_tv.text: Just static. Even the TV went to bed.

ch3_candy.speaker: leo
ch3_candy.text: Somebody put my candy up on the table so Biscuit can't get it.

ch3_off_porch.speaker: leo
ch3_off_porch.text: I'm not allowed off the porch at night. Just to the end of the street. Then right back.

ch3_sidewalk.speaker: leo
ch3_sidewalk.text: Every house is asleep. Even the jack-o'-lanterns blew out.

ch3_pillowcase.speaker: leo
ch3_pillowcase.text: Somebody dropped their whole haul. That's the worst thing that can happen on Halloween.

ch3_look_back.speaker: leo
ch3_look_back.text: Our house looks so small from here. I can't even find our window.

ch3_cross.speaker: leo
ch3_cross.text: Look both ways. No cars. No anything.

ch3_crickets.speaker: leo
ch3_crickets.text: The crickets are back. Only down here.

ch3_grandmas.speaker: leo
ch3_grandmas.text: It can't be Grandma's. Grandma's house is two hours away. But that's her rocking chair.

ch3_chair.speaker: leo
ch3_chair.text: It still creaks on the same board. She used to say it was singing.

ch3_bowl.speaker: leo
ch3_bowl.text: Full-size bars. Grandma always gave out full-size. Everybody knew.

gma_1.speaker: grandma
gma_1.text: Well, look who's up way past his bedtime.

ch3_leo_1.speaker: leo
ch3_leo_1.text: Mom said you weren't coming this year.

gma_2.speaker: grandma
gma_2.text: I know, sweet pea. I couldn't stay. But I wasn't going to go without saying goodnight.

gma_3.speaker: grandma
gma_3.text: I left the light on so you'd find me. You always did.

gma_4.speaker: grandma
gma_4.text: Not tonight. Your bed's at the other end of this street, and your daddy's going to come looking.

gma_5.speaker: grandma
gma_5.text: Take a candy bar. One. ...Oh, all right. Two.

ch3_take_bars.speaker: leo
ch3_take_bars.text: Will you keep the light on?

gma_6.speaker: grandma
gma_6.text: Always. Go on home now, Leo. Biscuit knows the way.

ch3_lights_on.speaker: leo
ch3_lights_on.text: They're coming back on. All the way home.

mom_morning_1.speaker: mom
mom_morning_1.text: Morning, sleepyhead. Did you sleep in your shoes?

mom_morning_2.speaker: mom
mom_morning_2.text: And where'd those come from? Nobody on this street gives out full-size bars.

ch4_mom_intro.speaker: mom
ch4_mom_intro.text: Okay, bud. We're just packing up the kitchen today. Stay where we can hear you.

dad_ch4_intro.speaker: dad
dad_ch4_intro.text: Any box with your name on it is yours. She labeled everything.

ch4_chair.speaker: leo
ch4_chair.text: Somebody put a sheet over her rocking chair. It looks like a ghost. A really sad ghost.

ch4_photo.speaker: leo
ch4_photo.text: That's me. I was a pumpkin. Grandma's holding me on her porch, and the light's on behind us.

ch4_leo_box.speaker: leo
ch4_leo_box.text: Every drawing I ever sent her. Even the bad ones. She kept all of them.

ch4_fridge.speaker: leo
ch4_fridge.text: My drawing of Biscuit is still on the fridge. I gave him six legs.

ch4_recipe.speaker: leo
ch4_recipe.text: Her cookie recipe. It says, a LOT of cinnamon. That's not a real amount.

ch4_pantry.speaker: leo
ch4_pantry.text: A whole box. Halloween, full size only. She was ready for next year.

dad_pantry.speaker: dad
dad_pantry.text: She bought them every November, when they went on sale. They're yours now, bud.

ch4_kitchen.speaker: leo
ch4_kitchen.text: It smells like her kitchen. Cinnamon. Just like the dream.

ch4_mom_porch.speaker: mom
ch4_mom_porch.text: Leo? Come out to the porch a sec?

ch4_mom_bulb.speaker: mom
ch4_mom_bulb.text: The new family won't want that old orange bulb. It was hers. Do you want it?

ch4_mom_funny.speaker: mom
ch4_mom_funny.text: ...That's funny. Nobody's turned that light on in weeks.

dad_ch4_car.speaker: dad
dad_ch4_car.text: Car's packed! Let's get home before dark.

ch5_mom_intro.speaker: mom
ch5_mom_intro.text: You're on candy duty this year, Leo. Porch light on means we're open.

ch5_leo_intro.speaker: leo
ch5_leo_intro.text: I know. I've got Grandma's bulb.

ch5_window.speaker: leo
ch5_window.text: Porch lights all the way down the street. Except the one at the very end.

ch5_window_repeat.speaker: leo
ch5_window_repeat.text: No smiley face this year. Okay. One smiley face.

ch5_tv.speaker: leo
ch5_tv.text: Spooky Hollow again. Some things don't change.

ch5_mask.speaker: leo
ch5_mask.text: This year I'm a robot. The box keeps sliding down over my eyes.

ch5_candy.speaker: leo
ch5_candy.text: Trade pile, keep pile. I'm nine now. I have a system.

ch5_couch.speaker: leo
ch5_couch.text: Not now. I'm on candy duty.

ch5_light_on.speaker: leo
ch5_light_on.text: There. Now anybody who's lost can find us.

ch5_switch_no_bulb.speaker: leo
ch5_switch_no_bulb.text: Not yet. Grandma's bulb goes in first.

ch5_fill_bowl.speaker: leo
ch5_fill_bowl.text: Grandma's box. Full size only. That's the rule.

kids_2.speaker: kids
kids_2.text: Trick or treat! Smell our feet!

ch5_full_size.speaker: leo
ch5_full_size.text: My grandma's house was the full-size house. Now ours is.

sammy_1.speaker: sammy
sammy_1.text: I can't find my brother. All the houses look the same in the dark.

ch5_leo_sammy.speaker: leo
ch5_leo_sammy.text: You can wait here with me. Our light's the orange one. He'll see it.

brother_1.speaker: brother
brother_1.text: Sammy! There you are! I saw the orange light all the way from the corner.

mom_ch5_late.speaker: mom
mom_ch5_late.text: Leo? Porch light stays on till the last trick-or-treaters go home.

ch5_leaving_on.speaker: leo
ch5_leaving_on.text: I know. I'm leaving it on a little longer.
